title: Ethernet Receive
text: Receive Ethernet packets from Simulink Real-Time target computer, 2 outputs, {Interface Name} sets Target computer Ethernet interface name wm0; {Data Width} sets the data port width in bytes, {Enable Simulink messages} sets the data as messages, {Maximum messages in a time step} limits packets per time step, {Capture filter} sets the filter on received packets character and {Sample Time} sets the sample time of block. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Interface Name
params.values: Target computer Ethernet interface name wm0 | wm1 | character vector

params.name: Data Width
params.values: Data port width in bytes 64 (default) | integer

params.name: Maximum messages in a time step
params.values: Limit packets per time step 1 (default) | integer

params.name: Capture filter
params.values: Filter on received packets character vector
